author: Penny Blacwrite
book_description: Gideon "GQ" Duke is the proud owner of Duke Electrical Services and a single father to fifteen-year-old Gianna. With a true icebox for a heart, GQ remained single for the last ten years. Sure, he'd maintain sexual relationships with a plethora of women, but he's always been stingy with his heart. That is, until he meets his Instagram crush, a sexy, smart BBW influencer named Eva, whom he's been obsessed with for years. He falls hard. He's doing all the things he thought he never would again, like tricking, simping, and giving his heart and soul to another woman.On a romantic rendezvous in Brazil with Eva, Gideon bumps into a ghost from his past. Words are exchanged. One thing leads to the next, and the next leads to the unthinkable. This altercation is the start of a spiraling chain of high-stress, high-stakes events that propel GQ into straight savage mode. A menace is born, a killer spawn, and he just can't stop.Makings Of A Menace follows the story of an overprotective father who goes to great lengths, putting his life and freedom on the line to protect his daughter and the woman he wants to spend the rest of his life with. Expect an alluring backstory, a web of lies, mind-blowing secrets, and explosive ending after explosive ending for each installment of this series. This is the Makings Of A Menace, by Penny Blacwrite.Show more
